codecs.method:
Isolated SkiaSharp 3.119.4 versus the current full SimdSkia codec adapter.

Build both benchmarks/CodecSkiaComparison projects first. All child processes
run serially; three alternating forks, owned RGBA outputs, no timed file IO.

    <projectUrl>https://github.com/sdcb/SimdCodecs</projectUrl>
    <description>Pure-managed PNG encoder + decoder for .NET. Writer: adaptive per-row filter selection (libpng "minimum sum of absolute values" heuristic), 8/16-bit RGBA/Gray. Reader: chunk parsing with CRC validation, color types 0/2/4/6 at 8/16-bit. Both sides handle iCCP / sRGB / gAMA / cHRM / eXIf metadata plus PNG-3 HDR signaling chunks cICP (Coding-Independent Code Points), mDCv (Mastering Display Color Volume), cLLI (Content Light Level Info) — full HDR10 / HLG round-trip. Also exports PngPredictor as a reusable row-unfilter building block (TIFF Predictor=2 / PDF FlateDecode). AOT-compatible.</description>

<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Sdcb.SimdCodecs.Jpeg</id>
    <version>1.4.0</version>
    <authors>sdcb</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/sdcb/SimdCodecs</projectUrl>
    <description>Pure-managed JPEG (ITU-T T.81 / ISO 10918) codec for .NET. Decoder: baseline sequential + progressive DCT, restart intervals, 4:4:4 / 4:2:2 / 4:2:0 / arbitrary chroma subsampling, grayscale, YCbCr, RGB-marked, and Adobe CMYK / YCCK (APP14) streams, plus scaled decode at 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 resolution via reduced inverse DCT — a 33-megapixel source can decode straight to a thumbnail-sized raster without the full-resolution intermediate ever existing. Encoder: baseline sequential (Annex K or per-image optimised Huffman tables) or progressive DCT, YCbCr 4:4:4 / 4:2:0 or single-component grey, quality 1..100, with Vector256 / Vector128 / scalar colour conversion and forward DCT that give identical output on every ISA; at the same quality it matches or beats libjpeg-turbo on luma PSNR and size. Decodes MCU row by MCU row straight into the caller's buffer (RGBA / BGRA / RGB at any stride) with no managed allocation and a working set of a few MCU rows, with Vector256 / Vector128 (SSE, AdvSimd) / scalar kernels that are bit-identical across ISAs; JpegSegmentScanner surfaces APPn metadata segments. Entropy decoding is coefficient-exact against libjpeg-turbo; sample reconstruction (single-precision IDCT, unrounded chroma interpolation, T.871 colour conversion) is at least as close to a double-precision reference as libjpeg-turbo's accurate mode. AOT-compatible.</description>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) 2026 sdcb</copyright>
    <tags>jpeg jpg image codec decoder encoder scaled idct thumbnail aot</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/sdcb/SimdCodecs.git" commit="afed708c5651e80be7fdbcf4398e0e94f3f6da01" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Sdcb.SimdCodecs.Abstractions" version="1.4.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
